title: Dispatch FLE 2: Mourners Remember Another Life of Dr. Voss
summary: Their accounts agree with one another and contradict the living explorer.
topic: A Funeral for a Living Eidetician
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: People who came to the church say Dr. Voss spent her last years teaching children in Kingsfen. She has never taught there. One mourner produced letters in which she discussed a husband and daughter; Dr. Voss has neither. The paper and ink appear to be ordinary.

Dr. Lenora Saye found a report of last month’s expedition that ended with Dr. Voss remaining in the Stratum. Its author is Dr. Voss herself. The living explorer says she wrote a different report and can produce it.
